verdicts.reason: A and B use almost the same layout, and both have the same problems. The 'Find It Near You' CTA sits at the top right above the headline, which breaks the reading order. It is stacked in one column with the three badges, so it reads as just another pill. The body copy is pushed into the bottom-right corner below the badges at a tiny size, and the product circle is cramped into the bottom left. The only difference is that B's FREE DELIVERY badge is tilted a bit more and sits a little lower, which makes no meaningful difference.
